name: cho-desktop
description: Multi-harness desktop GUI combining RapidAI/grok-build-desktop (ACP & subscription CLI wrapper) with vkotios/cli-agentic-coordinator (orch multi-agent worktree/review coordinator)

scripts.native:build: node apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && npm --workspace @cho-desktop/desktop run tauri -- build
scripts.test: npm --workspace @cho-desktop/acp-client run test && npm --workspace @cho-desktop/desktop run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @cho-desktop/acp-client run typecheck && npm --workspace @cho-desktop/desktop run typecheck
